headline_hook: Anthropic Launches Its Policy Institute While Claude Code Ships Side Conversations
preview_topics: the Anthropic Institute's societal AI agenda
why Karpathy says we need a bigger IDE

pick_of_the_day.thesis: AlphaEvolve producing novel combinatorics results marks the moment AI stopped being a calculator for known math and started being a collaborator in unknown math — and that distinction reshapes what 'AI for science' actually means.

model_literacy.relevance: Gemini Embedding 2 puts text, images, and video into a single vector space — understanding how cross-modal embeddings work explains why retrieval pipelines are about to get dramatically more capable.

items.title: Anthropic Founds the Anthropic Institute to Tackle AI's Societal Fallout
items.angle: Anthropic moves beyond safety research into policy and public engagement — a signal that frontier labs now see societal readiness as a core business function, not a side project.
items.key_fact: Dedicated institute focused on societal challenges from powerful AI

items.title: Google Ships Gemini Embedding 2 — Its First Fully Multimodal Embedding Model
items.angle: Text, images, and video in a single embedding space means cross-modal search and RAG pipelines just got a native foundation model instead of stitched-together workarounds.
items.key_fact: First Google embedding model covering text, image, and video in one space

items.title: Meta Ships Four Generations of Custom AI Silicon in Two Years
items.angle: Meta's MTIA chip cadence now matches its model cadence — custom silicon is becoming a competitive moat, not a side experiment.
items.key_fact: Four MTIA chip generations in two years

items.title: Fish Audio Drops s2-pro, a Next-Gen Open TTS Model
items.angle: Trending on HuggingFace with 240 likes — a serious open-weight option for teams building voice interfaces or audio content pipelines.

items.title: Claude Code Gets /btw — Side Conversations While the Agent Works
items.angle: The 'wait or interrupt' dilemma in agentic coding is solved — /btw lets you ask side questions without derailing Claude's main task, and 22K likes says developers were starving for this.
items.key_fact: 22,849 likes — most-engaged Claude Code feature drop in weeks

items.title: OpenAI Ships a Codex Skill to Automate GPT-5.4 Migration
items.angle: Model migration is now a one-click Codex skill — handles prompt adjustments, compatibility checks, and the swap itself.
items.key_fact: Dedicated Codex skill for automated model migration

items.title: Claude for Excel and PowerPoint Now Share Context Seamlessly
items.angle: Cross-app context sharing means spreadsheet data flows into decks without re-explaining — the enterprise workflow unlock Anthropic has been building toward.
items.key_fact: Bidirectional context sync between Excel and PowerPoint integrations

items.title: Gemini CLI Adds Plan Mode for Read-Only Exploration
items.angle: Explore and strategize before committing to changes — a safety-first pattern that every agentic CLI should steal.
items.key_fact: Read-only mode separates planning from execution

items.title: Why Your Agentic Coding Evals Are Lying to You
items.angle: Multi-percentage-point variance between identical eval runs means that single-number model comparisons are noise, not signal — essential context before your next model decision.
items.key_fact: Several percentage points of variance between identical eval runs

items.title: Simon Willison's Patterns for AI-Assisted Code That's Actually Better
items.angle: A practical guide that reframes the goal: AI should produce better code, not just faster code. Quality-first agentic engineering patterns.
items.key_fact: Comprehensive pattern guide from one of the most respected voices in AI tooling

items.title: LangChain Breaks Down the Anatomy of an Agent Harness
items.angle: The harness is the system that turns model intelligence into useful work — LangChain maps the core components every production agent needs.
items.key_fact: Core architectural breakdown of the model-to-action wrapper layer

items.title: AlphaEvolve Establishes New Results in Extremal Combinatorics
items.angle: DeepMind's system is now producing novel mathematical proofs, not just verifying known ones — AI as a genuine collaborator in pure math research.
items.key_fact: New results in extremal combinatorics established by AI

items.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Policy Connects World Models to Robot Control
items.angle: Bridging the sim-to-real gap: Cosmos Policy turns simulation-trained world foundation models into unified controllers for physical robots.
items.key_fact: World foundation model → robot manipulation policy pipeline

items.title: NVIDIA Publishes Methodology for Synthetic Code Training Data from Concept Seeds
items.angle: A replicable recipe for generating high-quality synthetic code data — practical for anyone fine-tuning code models without enough real training data.
items.key_fact: Large-scale synthetic dataset generated from programming concept seeds

items.title: Karpathy: The IDE Isn't Dying — It Needs to Level Up
items.angle: The basic unit of programming work is shifting upward, and tooling must match — Karpathy's 'bigger IDE' thesis reframes the agentic coding debate from 'will devs disappear' to 'what do devs need next.'
items.key_fact: 2,920 likes — the most-engaged take on dev tooling evolution this week

items.title: Security Researchers Use an AI Agent to Hack McKinsey's AI Platform
items.angle: AI-on-AI attack surfaces are real and here now — a case study every enterprise deploying agents needs to read before their next security review.
items.key_fact: Detailed writeup of AI agent compromising a major consulting firm's AI platform

items.title: Anthropic Opens Sydney Office — Fourth in Asia-Pacific
items.angle: Tokyo, Bengaluru, Seoul, now Sydney — Anthropic's APAC expansion signals both a talent play and regulatory engagement across four distinct AI markets.
items.key_fact: Fourth APAC office after Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Seoul

items.title: Open-Source Browser Protocol Built for AI Agents
items.angle: Standard browsers weren't designed for agents — this protocol handles navigation, interaction, and extraction natively for autonomous workflows.
items.key_fact: Open-source, purpose-built for agent browsing patterns

quick_links.angle: Mutable storage optimized for AI checkpoints — fills the biggest gap in git-based ML workflows
quick_links.key_fact: S3-like storage with dedup for successive model checkpoints

quick_links.angle: Embedding inference at scale now runs on latest NVIDIA hardware
quick_links.key_fact: Native Blackwell support in Text Embeddings Inference

quick_links.angle: AI tool uptime now matters as much as capability — infrastructure growing pains
quick_links.key_fact: Elevated login errors and performance degradation reported

quick_links.angle: Open-source autonomous device control tool sparks a wave of businesses in China
